title: Stationary Ball Control Series
description: A seated, stationary ball-handling series — pound dribbles, figure-eights around the chair frame and quick taps — building hand control before any pushing is added.

content.objective: Build pure hand control with the ball before pushing is added to the picture.
content.setup: Each player sits in their chair with a ball and open space around them.
instructions: Pound-dribble the ball low beside the chair for 20 touches with the right hand.
Switch to the left hand for 20 touches.
Figure-eight the ball around and under the frame between the wheels for 20 seconds.
Finish with 15 seconds of quick fingertip taps on top of the ball.
coachingPoints: Use the fingertips, not the palm, for every touch.
Keep the ball low and close to the chair, not out in front.
Build speed only once control is solid.
commonMistakes: Letting the dribble drift too far from the chair to control safely.
Using the palm instead of the fingertips, which flattens the bounce.
Watching the ball instead of keeping the head up.
content.safety: Leave space between players so a loose ball doesn't roll into a neighbour.
